text.text: The NetApp E2712 delivers configurable, streamlined performance for midsize application-driven SAN storage environments. The scalable E2712 provides general-purpose application-driven storage for remote, branch, and midsize organizations. Choose from three shelves—4U/60, 2U/24, and 2U/12—and three forms of connectivity: FC, iSCSI, or SAS. The E2700 integrates with key applications such as VMware ® , Exchange, SQL, and Oracle ® systems.
